name: Hierarchical Data Modeling Framework (HDMF)
contribution: Created the GenericDataChunkIterator for more efficient lazy, buffered writing of terabyte-scale datasets (existing defaults overlapped chunks and had poor default chunking heuristics), later extending it with serialization, parallel orchestration, and progress bar control.
description: Enhanced a generic schema language for defining structured data standards intended to be written to group-like backend file types (such as HDF5 and Zarr) by generalizing, parallelizing, and optimizing lazy data buffering for terabyte-scale datasets.
